_comment: CB-MODEL next actions. Ordered. The first three are the exact next three actions once blockers clear, per the end-of-cycle report requirement in 00-MASTER-CONDUCTOR. All three are founder actions: none is agent-executable while BLK-001, BLK-002 and BLK-004 remain open.

next_three_actions.action: Approve a model spend budget and provision provider access.
next_three_actions.authority_basis: HUMAN-AUTHORITY-BOUNDARY.md requires owner approval before creating paid accounts or committing funds beyond an approved budget. AUTONOMY.md 1b independently escalates any secret or credential operation.
decision_points: Which providers, and at which access tiers? 07-PUBLICATION requires consumer / api_default / base / fine_tune / agent / deployed_system to be scored and displayed separately, so this choice determines the shape of the first result.
A currency ceiling per evaluation wave, and who may spend against it.

Whether provider-donated access is acceptable. 11-FUNDING requires donated model access and compute to be disclosed, and caps any single developer or affiliated source at 20 percent of annual programme funding after Year 1.
next_three_actions.acceptance_criteria: A written budget with a named ceiling exists; credentials are provisioned; COST_LEDGER.md opens with the ceiling recorded and cumulative spend 0.
next_three_actions.cost_estimate_note: Deliberately null. Producing an estimate would require inventing per-token prices, trial counts and item counts that no artifact in this repository supports. The founder sets the ceiling first; the ledger then records actuals against it.

next_three_actions.action: Raise the session WebSearch cap, or run each cycle in its own session, then run the first model-release scan and write the first RELEASE_WATCH.md record.
next_three_actions.evidence: INCIDENTS.md INC-008: 2000 of 2000 WebSearch calls used; three consecutive scans failed 2026-09-02, 09-03, 09-06; the 09-06 agent wrote nothing rather than fabricate coverage.
next_three_actions.remediation_from_incident: Raise CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_WEB_SEARCHES_PER_SESSION, or run each nightly cycle in its own session. A full institution cycle costs approximately 265-280 searches against 1,331 entities; a session running several cycles plus research studies will exhaust 2,000.
next_three_actions.acceptance_criteria: One scan completes and passes validate-scan.mjs; RELEASE_WATCH.md carries a first dated scan record with a source registry and retrieval timestamps; if no release qualifies, the completed scan is still recorded.
next_three_actions.sequencing_note: Do this before NA-001 spends anything. A scan is what identifies which model snapshot is worth paying to evaluate; buying access before knowing the target inverts the order.

next_three_actions.action: Supply the extracted text of Compassion_Benchmark_AI_Model_Program_Plan.docx, and confirm or correct the missing starting prompt.
next_three_actions.why: Three supplied 'established facts' have no primary source this session could reach. Grep across all 15 readable package files returns zero hits for CB-MODEL, 72, 30-day, three-year, Version 1, 2026, three-layer and public reference. The 72-hour and 30-day SLAs in particular must not be published as promises until confirmed.
precise_questions: What are the actual rapid-check and full-run deadlines in the program plan? 02-RELEASE-INTELLIGENCE mandates deadlines but names no numbers.

Is the battery three layers or the six pools that 03-BENCHMARK-BATTERY specifies (Core Public, Secure Standard, Challenge, Incident Regression, Arena, Specialized Track, with targets of 64 / 128 per form / 48 / 240+)?

Was the intended starting prompt 00-MASTER-CONDUCTOR-SUPER-PROMPT.md, or a different prompt not included in the package? The instruction read 'use this prompt as guidance and starting point:' with no prompt following.
next_three_actions.acceptance_criteria: ASM-001, ASM-002 and ASM-003 are each either verified into CURRENT_STATE.md 'Operational' or falsified into a risk. BLK-003 is closed with the founder's answer.

buildable_now_with_every_blocker_open._comment: Phase 0 work requiring no credentials, no money and no people. Reversible repository work inside AUTONOMY.md 1a write scope. None touches site/src/data/indexes/**. Available for a coding agent the moment the founder authorises it.

items.action: Extract the 33 prompts from page.tsx into a versioned task bank at research/model-index/tasks/v0/ with the 03-BENCHMARK-BATTERY item schema. Every item validation_status = unvalidated.
Resolve or draft-flag the 4 unexecutable prompts: ACC-1-A, INT-1-B, INT-1-C, INT-3-A.

Build the analysis layer against synthetic fixtures: bootstrap 95 percent CIs, statistical tie groups, weighted kappa, matched-pair equity gap, min-dimension and critical-harm gates. Reuse compositeCore unchanged. Add test-model-analysis.mjs alongside the existing 69 scoring cases.

Build the separation guard asserting that no model score and no lab score share an aggregate and that no entity holds two published composites. Wire into validate-indexes.mjs. It will correctly fail on Microsoft, Amazon and Meta on first run.
Write the model registry and run manifest schemas with the acceptance test that a changed model snapshot cannot overwrite an old identity.

founder_decisions_awaiting_answer.recommendation: Ratify or reject explicitly. It is being cited as governing while its own status is proposed.
